title: Describing People & 'to be'

scenes.t: {name} learns to describe people: their looks and their personality.
Looks: tall, short, curly hair, straight hair, long hair, short hair, brown eyes.
Personality: funny, shy, friendly, helpful, polite. I am funny. I make my friends laugh.
This is my friend Mona. She has long black hair and brown eyes.
Mona is very kind and friendly. She always helps her friends when they need help.
Everyone likes to play with Mona. It is good to help your friends when in need.
We use 'to be': I am, you are, he is, she is, it is, we are, they are.

items.a: Not short. She can reach the top shelf.
He doesn't like to talk much.
She helps when someone needs help.

activities.title: Memory Game
activities.prompt: Match the opposite or describing words.

activities.title: am, is or are?
activities.prompt: Which form of 'to be' goes with it?

why.is: We use 'is' with he, she, it or one person.
why.are: We use 'are' with you, we, they.

items.q: My friend helps me. She is…
He makes me laugh. He is…
She doesn't talk a lot. She is…

o: curly red hair and green eyes
short brown hair and blue eyes
long black hair and brown eyes

items.q: People like Mona because she is…

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 13–18
